purpose: Make the volatility exposure a declared decision instead of an unwatched accident. Step 189 found every saved strategy sits well above the panel's median volatility, and that a high-volatility tilt alone explains most of the return ranking. Nothing in the existing gate battery measures this.

measure.statistic: weight-weighted mean cross-sectional volatility percentile of held single names
measure.percentile_universe: all issuers in the SEC broad price panel with sufficient history
measure.note: 0.50 means the book holds names of typical volatility. 1.00 means it holds the most volatile names available.

thresholds.rationale: A book inside the neutral band is not making a volatility bet. Between 0.60 and 0.65 the bet must be declared and sized deliberately. Above 0.75 the strategy is a leveraged volatility bet wearing a stock-selection label, whatever its stated rules.

gate_rules.bear_evidence_note: Any book tilted above the neutral band must show how it behaves in a falling market before promotion. No SEC strategy here can currently supply that, because the stock price panel starts 2022-12-02.

applies_to: every candidate evaluated from Step 190 onward
